fullPassage:
Online shopping has been much more popular in recent years. It is expected to continue to grow, given how digitalization and the internet allow companies to sell without a physical presence. Factors such as convenience, a wider selection of goods, and lower prices have contributed to the increase in online shopping. Let's explore the biggest online shopping trends and see where things are headed.
First, more people will shop through social commerce. Social media and SNS services have become increasingly popular places for consumers to discover, research, and purchase products. Social commerce makes shopping a more convenient and interactive experience, which helps explain why it's become so popular. Features like "buy" buttons and instant messaging tools make social media easy to use. In 2021, around 96.9 million US shoppers made a purchase through social media. Looking ahead, this trend is unlikely to slow down. In the US, social commerce earnings are estimated to reach nearly $80 billion by 2025. Plus, by 2025, the number of social commerce buyers in the United States is forecasted to reach over 114 million.
Second, more shoppers will use voice searches. Voice assistants were once used only to get directions, to answer questions about weather, or to call someone. But the way people use voice searches is changing. Voice assistants are now becoming a core component of online shopping. In 2022, as much as $40 billion of sales used a voice search. This represents a significant leap compared to the $2 billion worth of sales in 2017. It appears shoppers are only going to increase their use of voice searches.

questions.passage: Online shopping has been much more popular in recent years. Factors such as (A)[convenience / convention], a wider selection of goods, and lower prices have (B)[contributed / distributed] to the increase in online shopping. Let's (C)[explore / exploit] the biggest online shopping trends and see where things are headed. Let's explore the biggest online shopping trends and see where things are headed. First, more people will shop through social commerce. Social media and SNS services have become increasingly popular places for consumers to discover, research, and purchase products.
questions.stem: (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 편리함(convenience), 더 넓은 선택의 폭, 더 낮은 가격 같은 요소들이 온라인 쇼핑 증가에 기여해 왔다(contributed). 가장 큰 온라인 쇼핑 트렌드를 탐구하고(explore) 향후 방향을 살펴보자.
det.analysis:
✅ ① convenience–contributed–explore: 모두 원문 그대로 적합
❌ ② exploit(착취하다)은 탐구 맥락에 부적합
❌ ③ convention(관습)은 편리함이 아님, distributed(분배하다)는 contributed(기여하다)와 다름
❌ ④ 전부 부적합
det.tip: convenience(편리함) vs convention(관습/대회) / contributed to(~에 기여하다) vs distributed(분배하다) / explore(탐구하다) vs exploit(착취하다)

questions.passage: Factors such as convenience, a wider selection of goods, and lower prices have contributed to the increase in online shopping. Let's explore the biggest online shopping trends and see where things are headed. Social commerce makes shopping a more convenient and (A)[interactive / attractive] experience, which helps explain why it's become so popular. In the US, social commerce earnings are (B)[estimated / eliminated] to reach nearly $80 billion by 2025. Plus, by 2025, the number of social commerce buyers is (C)[forecasted / forced] to reach over 114 million. Features like "buy" buttons and instant messaging tools make social media easy to use.
questions.stem: (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 소셜 커머스는 쇼핑을 더 편리하고 상호작용적인(interactive) 경험으로 만든다. 미국에서 소셜 커머스 수익은 2025년까지 약 800억 달러에 달할 것으로 추정된다(estimated). 또한, 구매자 수는 1억 1,400만 명 이상에 도달할 것으로 예측된다(forecasted).
det.analysis:
✅ ③ interactive–estimated–forecasted: 모두 원문 적합
❌ ① attractive(매력적인)은 그럴듯하나 원문은 interactive
❌ ② eliminated(제거된)와 forced(강제된)는 문맥에 부적합
❌ ④ 전부 부적합
det.tip: interactive(상호작용적인) vs attractive(매력적인) / estimated(추정되는) vs eliminated(제거된) / forecasted(예측되는) vs forced(강제된)

questions.passage: Second, more shoppers will use voice searches. Voice assistants are now becoming a core (A)[component / complement] of online shopping. In 2022, as much as $40 billion of sales used a voice search. This represents a (B)[significant / superficial] leap compared to the $2 billion worth of sales in 2017. It appears shoppers are only going to (C)[increase / decrease] their use of voice searches. This represents a significant leap compared to the $2 billion worth of sales in 2017.
questions.stem: (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 음성 비서는 이제 온라인 쇼핑의 핵심 구성 요소(component)가 되고 있다. 이는 2017년 20억 달러 매출에 비해 상당한(significant) 도약을 나타낸다. 쇼핑객들은 음성 검색 사용을 증가시킬(increase) 것으로 보인다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① component–significant–increase: 모두 원문 적합
❌ ② decrease(감소)는 사용 증가 맥락에 반대
❌ ③ complement(보완물)은 component(구성 요소)과 미묘히 다름, superficial(피상적인)은 significant의 반의어
❌ ④ 전부 부적합
det.tip: component(구성 요소) vs complement(보완물) / significant(상당한) vs superficial(피상적인) / $2B→$40B = significant leap

questions.passage: Online shopping has been much more popular in recent years. It is expected to continue to grow, given how digitalization and the internet allow companies to sell without a ①<u>physical</u> presence. Factors such as convenience, a wider ②<u>selection</u> of goods, and lower prices have contributed to the ③<u>increase</u> in online shopping. Let's explore the biggest online shopping trends and see where things are ④<u>stagnating</u>.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 낱말 중 문맥상 부적절한 것은?

det.korean: 온라인 쇼핑은 최근 몇 년간 훨씬 더 인기 있어졌다. 기업들이 ①물리적(physical) 존재 없이 판매할 수 있게 해주는 디지털화. 더 넓은 ②선택(selection)의 폭. 온라인 쇼핑의 ③증가(increase)에 기여. 어디로 ④정체되고 있는지(stagnating) 살펴보자 → 원문: headed(향하고 있는지)
det.analysis:
✅ 정답 ④: stagnating(정체되는)은 headed(향하는)의 반의어. 트렌드를 탐구하고 '향후 방향'을 살펴보는 맥락.
❌ ① physical(물리적인)은 원문 적합
❌ ② selection(선택)은 원문 적합
❌ ③ increase(증가)는 원문 적합
det.tip: headed(향하고 있는) ↔ stagnating(정체되는). 'where things are headed'는 '향후 방향'을 의미하는 관용표현

questions.passage: Social media and SNS services have become increasingly popular places for consumers to ①<u>discover</u>, research, and purchase products. Social commerce makes shopping a more ②<u>complicated</u> and interactive experience, which helps explain why it's become so popular. Features like "buy" buttons and instant messaging tools make social media ③<u>easy</u> to use. In 2021, around 96.9 million US shoppers ④<u>made</u> a purchase through social media.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 낱말 중 문맥상 부적절한 것은?

det.korean: 소비자들이 제품을 ①발견하고(discover) 구매하는 장소. 쇼핑을 더 ②복잡한(complicated) 경험으로 만든다 → 원문: convenient(편리한). 소셜 미디어를 ③쉽게(easy) 사용할 수 있다. 9,690만 명이 ④구매했다(made).
det.analysis:
✅ 정답 ②: complicated(복잡한)는 convenient(편리한)의 반의어. 소셜 커머스가 쇼핑을 '편리한' 경험으로 만드는 맥락.
❌ ① discover(발견하다)는 원문 적합
❌ ③ easy(쉬운)는 원문 적합
❌ ④ made(했다)는 원문 적합
det.tip: convenient(편리한) ↔ complicated(복잡한). 소셜 커머스의 장점: 편리하고 상호작용적인 경험

questions.passage: Voice assistants were once used only to get ①<u>directions</u>, to answer questions about weather, or to call someone. But the way people use voice searches is changing. Voice assistants are now becoming a core ②<u>component</u> of online shopping. In 2022, as much as $40 billion of sales used a voice search. This represents a ③<u>minor</u> leap compared to the $2 billion worth of sales in 2017. It appears shoppers are only going to ④<u>increase</u> their use of voice searches.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 낱말 중 문맥상 부적절한 것은?

det.korean: 음성 비서는 한때 ①길 안내(directions)를 받거나 날씨를 묻는 데만 사용되었다. 이제 온라인 쇼핑의 핵심 ②구성 요소(component)가 되고 있다. 이것은 2017년 대비 ③사소한(minor) 도약을 나타낸다 → 원문: significant(상당한). 쇼핑객들은 사용을 ④증가시킬(increase) 것이다.
det.analysis:
✅ 정답 ③: minor(사소한)는 significant(상당한)의 반의어. $2B→$40B는 20배 증가로 '상당한' 도약.
❌ ① directions는 원문 적합
❌ ② component는 원문 적합
❌ ④ increase는 원문 적합
det.tip: significant(상당한) ↔ minor(사소한). $2 billion → $40 billion = 20배 성장, 'significant leap'이 적절

This represents a significant leap compared to the $2 billion worth of sales in 2017. It appears shoppers are only going to increase their use of voice searches.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 <u>grow</u>와 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.korean: 온라인 쇼핑은 계속 성장할(grow) 것으로 예상된다.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ decline(감소하다): grow의 반의어
❌ ① expand(확장하다): grow의 동의어
❌ ② accelerate(가속하다): 반의어 아님
❌ ④ maintain(유지하다): 성장도 감소도 아닌 중립
det.tip: grow(성장하다) ↔ decline(감소하다/쇠퇴하다). shrink, decrease, diminish도 반의어

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 <u>significant</u>와 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.korean: 이것은 2017년 대비 상당한(significant) 도약을 나타낸다.
det.analysis:

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 (A)와 (B)의 'reach'가 각각 의미하는 바로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: (A) 수익이 약 800억 달러에 도달할(reach) 것으로 추정. (B) 구매자 수가 1억 1,400만 명 이상에 도달할(reach over) 것으로 예측.
det.analysis:
✅ ② (A) 도달하다 – (B) 넘어서다: (A)는 nearly(거의)와 함께 '도달하다', (B)는 over(이상)와 함께 '넘어서다/초과하다'
